notes.title: 8/15/25 Large Patch
notes.notes: [p]-fixed bug that was making bubble detection and hidden gem companies not be detected properly (oops)[/p][p]-fixed bug that was making total outstanding shares for a company change at certain company threshholds, this will unfortunately mess up legacy saves by changing stock prices dramatically for every company, I could add legacy protection to avoid this but that would take up more time and considering this is still prerelease I think it's fine, I wouldn't do this if the game was actually live. (this took forever to fix so thats why i havent updated in a bit)[/p][p]-Reworked bond system, it now has set times each year to do bond rate shifts, alligned with the real world federal open market comittee standard meeting times I found online. I also adjusted how the calculated bond rate is done to hopefully be more realistic.[/p][p]-removed all placeholder emojis, i will be adding my own art instead over time where i think it's important.[/p][p]-renamed jobs tab to career[/p][p]-adjusted some company growth/shrink rate so it shouldnt be as unrealistically dramatic year to year while still allowing for big dips/climbs[/p][p]-Fixed various tax bugs, this took a while but all sources of income should be taxed correctly[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Next: [/p][p]-Adding more companies[/p][p]-Art overhaul, up to now I've been mainly focused on mechanics but now I'm at the point where presentation needs to be enhanced, any suggestions or feedback are welcome[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]I'm getting pretty close to a final release here, hope it goes well :)[/p]

notes.title: 8/6/25 Patch
notes.notes: [p]-made short tab in stock trading panel non scrollable, so you can see it all without having to scroll[/p][p]-fixed bug that doubled a old daily expenses that i forgot to remove, oops![/p][p]-changed number formatting in stats widget[/p][p]-reworked raise system, now simply does 2-8% pay bump randomly (weighted for lower raises) and happens on Jan 15th[/p][p]-reworked promotion system, now simply promotes once per year if you have xp requirement on Jan 15th with a minimum 8% pay bump[/p][p]-made player stats in your career tab show the max age of 80[/p][p]-reworked inflation, its not just a constant tick, it now can go up and down and even have deflation (needs testing but should be fully functional)[/p][p]-gave each government spending category impact macro economic factors directly to make them matter more. What these are can be see in the "T" menu in lobbying. (may need future rebalancing)[/p][p][/p][p]I'm struggling to think of how to do the job/education rework I want that won't totally fuck over legacy saves, I want to have each job and education have like specific prerequisites instead of just a xp requirement, would be slightly more realistic and more interactive, I'm pretty unsatisified with the current job system, I know it's an idle game but it's way too 1 dimensional from a gameplay perspective with very little actually interesting choices to make. But it's very foundational to the gameplay so I can't remove it. Gonna need to work on it for a while.[/p]

notes.title: 8/3/25 Mini-patch
notes.notes: [p]-Added player stats section in your career in job application ui.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 8/3/25
notes.notes: [p]-added bubble pop mechanic, the larger a company's market share, the larger chance it has to get a random mood penalty, to mimic bubbles popping.[/p][p]-government not more wary of increasing taxes when there is a surplus, as well as increasing spending with surpluses, this should help reduce the long term issue of governments creating giant treasuries with unealistic and unhealthy surpluses[/p][p]-removed family system, doesnt really add much, may readd a similar system later but its currently just bloating design and not adding any fun or interesting mechanics.[/p][p]-removed lifestyle system, will definitely readd something similar later but it's current implementation was terrible[/p][p]-fixed a bug that was causing index xp requirement readiness to be out of sync with reality which made it sometimes say you didnt have the requirements when you actually did.[/p][p]-fixed initialization error with new saves with market graph[/p][p]-made my portfolio in stock trading panel not scroll horizontally[/p][p]-added additional info to your portfolio in the long tab[/p][p]-bank loans not taxed now so they should be much more usable now[/p][p]-added mechanic where companies with smaller market caps are more likely to get mood boosts (to simulate hidden gems and incentivize players to go for small companies with potentially bad moods, although that should still be risky)[/p][p]-cleaned up outdated dividend displays which showed innacurate and different information, should all be the same now (and look cleaner)[/p]

notes.title: 7/30/25 Patch Notes
notes.notes: [p]-changed game on windows to OpenGL instead of vulkan for potential stability fixes (should fix the long term afk crashing issue)[/p][p]-changed mood based growth to make positive moods grow slightly slower and made crash mood more severe[/p][p]-change intiail stock values to be random instead of evenly divided among the 19 trillion start. (Total is still always 19 trillion at start of game)[/p][p]-minor save manager fix that made companies not get moods or initial values when creating a game until stock market scene is entered[/p][p]-fixed stock tax basis tracking issue[/p][p]-Graph now adjusts to oldest data rather than always comparing percent change to initial value of 19 trillion[/p][p]Next:[/p][p]-Reworking education/job system to have specific required education/previous experience to get a job instead of just xp[/p][p]-Rework company system to clean up some technical debt so that future jobs, companies, industries and stuff like that can more easily be added in the future.[/p][p]-Rework stock/short system to be closer to bonds so that you can sell specific shorts of each company you own indivually, which also makes keeping track of things like taxes much easier for the player.[/p][p]-Make family system more logical, the way family members gain capital is very unrealistic and they live for way too long.[/p][p]-Optimize market graph so that more history can be added (I have made multiple attempts at this but will keep doing this until I get it working)[/p][p]-Add graphs for each company, and maybe some other variables like population for debt and stuff[/p][p]-Add proper short tax tracking, it currently taxes all of the income instead of just profit which makes shorts extrememly weak[/p][p]-Add better tutorial/learning tools, I've gotten playback from multiple play testers that the systems are confusing, although I am building off of real world complicated economic stuff, I should always try to improve the user experience.[/p]

notes.title: Bug Fixes 7/15/25
notes.notes: [p]-made moods based on float values not on integers that round up, making stock market more positive sided while maintaining volatility[/p][p][/p][p]-different industries no longer are affected by certain mood events more than others as its now just a simple +2 to -2 float change rather than a list of different events, might add back later[/p][p][/p][p]-added beginners luck in realism, first application in each realism game should always accept you, might revert this later since its not really realistic but it is huge for player experience[/p][p][/p][p]-job application cooldown is now tracked correctly when exiting a save and loading/creating another or when closing the game entirely and reentering the save.[/p][p][/p][p]-bandaid fix for graph that sends you to govstats scene when in graphs for over and hour, might work idk its hard to quickly test if the fix will work when it takes hours to see if it crashes[/p][p][/p][p]I'm going to continue to try and find a proper fix for the graph bug especially if the band-aid fix doesn't seem to work. [/p][p]Next: I plan on making governments increase spending and reduce taxes when treasury gets really big, as currently its possible for the government to maintain huge surpluses even with hundreds of trillions in the treasury. I also am going to make total market value less stable as current implementation is too positive sided and safe, although there is decent volatility within each indivual stock. I am also looking into a system to potentially procedurally generate more companies over time, although this feature is still early in development so don't expect it for a bit.[/p][p]Thanks and have fun playing[/p]

notes.title: Bug Fix 7/14/25
notes.notes: [p]-fixed short bug that used outdated stock price calculation causing stocks to cost more than they actually do for shorts making the short button not work in many circumstance[/p][p]-fixed some graph data initializing issues that would sometimes give incorrect data points[/p][p]-changed graph to just be green instead of being red when under starting 19 trillion market cap[/p][p]-fixed all stock income being taxed, it now more realistically only taxes the profit.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]There currently is some stability problems, probably stemming from the graph system that seems to be crashing the game after several hours, if you encounter this please let me know I am actively trying to fix it as being able to afk for extended periods of time without worrying is a high priority for idle game like this. [/p]
